assertions.name: colored_lr_at_root_scope_a_excluded_as_valuemap_carrier
assertions.source: Exact fifth-root arithmetic: colouring the p3=5 fibre reflection-collapses to D=2 (K2), is bounded by 1/sin(pi/5) < the growing target ratios (K3), and the mark-6 split node is outside the single-fibre colour range with 2[3] != [5]_q0+1 (K4). The value map [mark]_q0 is a real-q0 growing object; the Sigma(2,3,5) root-level colored modulus cannot be it. Scope-(a): this specific root-level construction; the q0-continuation remains the genuine open gap.

description: s013 Front-2: the COLORED Lawrence-Rozansky modulus vs the McKay value map. Colours the p3=5 fibre of the machine-validated Sigma(2,3,5) S-matrix (keystone_valuemap_genuine_smatrix_s013, cited) by a Wilson line alpha=1..4 and computes the fifth-root quantum dims [alpha]_k = sin(alpha k pi/5)/sin(k pi/5) at both flat connections EXACTLY. K1: alpha=1 recovers the unit anchor. K2: reflection alpha=4=1, alpha=3=2 collapses to <=2 independent moduli per flat -> colouring the p3=5 fibre does NOT escape the D=2 vacuum row. K3: |[alpha]_k| <= 1/sin(pi/5)=1.7013 while the target ratios (1,[4]_q0,[5]_q0,[5]_q0+1)~(1,4.11,5.22,6.22) grow past it -- the value map is a REAL-q0 growing object, not a root-level modulus. K4: mark 6 (electron split node) exceeds the fibre order 5, and the 3+3' two-block 2[3]_k~3.24 does not reproduce the target [5]_q0+1=6.22 ('[6]_zeta vs [5]_zeta+1' criterion). Verdict: colored-LR-at-Sigma(2,3,5)-root is scope-(a) EXCLUDED as the value-map carrier; refines (not contradicts) the ledger -- the genuine open object is the q0-continuation. No fit; nothing wired; Lean loc_matches gate stays open.
